question: Two parallel lines touch the circles at P and Q. Area of the circle is 154 cm². Find the length of PQ (Take pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given :**

Area of the circle is 154 cm2.

**Formula used:**

Area of a circle = π × radius2

**Concept used:**

Diameter = 2 × radius

Two parallel lines touch the circles at P and Q so the length of PQ = Diametrer

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69f766401c9ec0d51c89e3527125af9725b059ba7ca855df3d2f83eef005e7a9.png] 

As per the question,

 π×r² = 154

⇒ r = 7

The diameter will be 7 × 2 = 14 cm

The length of PQ = 14 cm

∴ The correct option is 2
